verdict.rationale: The evidence supports component-based modularity: community reports describe single-file components that bundle a component's HTML, JS and styles (vue-comm-8), and the docs describe an incrementally adoptable, scalable ecosystem (vue-docs-2). Nothing in the pack documents a dependency-injection mechanism, and one community comment says reaching for a global store breaks component modularity (vue-comm-19). missing for 10: any documentation of a dependency-injection mechanism, first-party docs on structuring apps into modules, independent hands-on corroboration of DI-based composition.
